proposal.summary: Reflected or stored cross-site scripting in General Solutions Steiner GmbH CASE 3 Taskmanagement V 3.3 via the fieldname parameter allowing execution of arbitrary web scripts or HTML.
proposal.affected_product: General Solutions Steiner GmbH CASE 3 Taskmanagement V 3.3
proposal.cwe_quote: A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in General Solutions Steiner GmbH CASE 3 Taskmanagement V 3.3 allows attackers to execute arbitrary web scripts or HTML via a crafted payload injected into the fieldname parameter.
